description: Every read form consults the get half: a plain read, an object binding pattern and template interpolation all report against a throwing getter, while assigning to the same member consults the clean setter and passes.

diagnostics.message: Reading `box.value` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `value`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the getter `value` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
